data.one_liner: Draggable, scrollable, and snapping bottom sheet widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom sheet widget that supports snapping to multiple extents, scrolling content, headers, footers, and can be used as a permanent widget or a dialog.
use_when: You need a bottom sheet that can snap to multiple height positions.
You want custom headers and footers that remain fixed while the content scrolls inside the sheet.
avoid_when: You only need the standard Material persistent or modal bottom sheets provided by Flutter SDK.
strengths: Supports multiple snap positions and custom positioning modes.
Includes built-in support for fixed headers and footers.
Can be used directly in the widget tree or shown as a dialog.
weaknesses: Children like ListViews require specific configurations (like shrinkWrap and NeverScrollableScrollPhysics) to avoid layout errors.
Limited documentation outside of the README.
